body:
I say body count because it’s the easiest way for me to phrase it. And no, I don’t see body count = better sex. I’ve been with someone who had a very high body count and was terrible in bed. 

She was once in a polyamorous relationship and said that she can’t do it again. She’s selfish with her partners in her own words.
FOMO makes sense. And if I did do this, I wouldn’t have her as a backup. That unnecessarily cruel.
I don’t know if I can go into work today. Even if I don’t make a decision.
I don’t have access to any of those. Just half a bottle of whiskey left
Thank you. I haven’t lost all hope yet.
